subject: Provisional trial credits for Orbis Labs — qualification details
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam@orbis.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-04-09T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Trial credit request: Orbis Labs pilot

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the latency and cost savings looked promising. We are preparing a small pilot at Orbis Labs to power a knowledge retrieval assistant for our beta customers and wanted to explore Redwood trial credits to accelerate the integration.

High-level details:
- Pilot scope: support 5k monthly active users, ~12 tokens per query average, estimated 1.2M tokens over 60 days
- Target start: late April, run for 60-90 days
- Security: we are SOC2 in progress; happy to share our security pack

Request: provisional credits to cover the pilot (ballpark $12k in hosted credits) and a 90-day trial window. If it helps, we can commit to a quick MTTR metric measurement and share results against the success criteria below.

Success criteria:
- 80% query latency under 400ms
- Average cost per query reduction of 20% vs current setup

Can you confirm what documentation you need and whether a provisional credit approval is possible ahead of our legal review?

Thanks,
Liam O'Connor
Head of Product
Orbis Labs
liam@orbis.ai

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@orbis.ai>
Cc: Avery Johnson <avery@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-04-09T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Trial credit request: Orbis Labs pilot

Hi Liam — great to meet yesterday, and appreciate the clear success criteria.

We can provisionally approve a pilot credit allocation to accelerate your tests. Tentative offer: $15,000 in hosted credits active for 90 days, subject to a short security checklist and an MSA signature within 30 days. If the pilot metrics align with the success criteria we discussed, we can discuss a follow-on committed arrangement with discounted unit pricing.

Next steps I need from you:
- Completed security questionnaire (I attached our onboarding checklist with the specific items we need)
- Confirmation of the account owner for billing and a point person for the integration (Sana?)
- Approximate launch date

I have looped in Avery to confirm the credit exception for the proposed amount and Neha will assist on the security questionnaire review.

Attachments: pilot-onboarding-checklist.pdf (PDF)

If anything in the terms above is a blocker, flag it and I will escalate. Otherwise I will request provisional credit activation today pending a quick internal review.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Startup Programs
Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

Hi Liam and Sana —

Thanks for the prompt response and for confirming Sana as the integration lead. We have approved a provisional allocation as follows:

- Credits: $15,000 hosted credits
- Window: 90 days from activation date
- Conditions: completed security questionnaire and MSA signature within 30 days; credits may be paused if questionnaire responses indicate an unresolved control gap
- Success follow-up: short MTTR and metrics review at day 30 and final review at day 75

I created HubSpot deal DL-2028-091 and attached the onboarding checklist for ease. Please return the completed security questionnaire by end of week and we will activate the credits on receipt. If you need the credits earlier we can provisionally toggle them on and mark them as conditional in the console so you can start integration work.

Attachments: security-questionnaire-answers.xlsx (please return completed), pilot-onboarding-checklist.pdf

Related links: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/3456-ORBL-091 and the pilot plan here: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1a2b3c-orbis-pilot-plan/view

Sana, happy to set up a 30-minute integration sync tomorrow or Thursday to walk through the onboarding checklist and SDK keys.

Best,
